entries.quote: A leader is one who knows the way, goes the way, and shows the way.
entries.author: John C. Maxwell
entries.task: Identify one person you lead today and ask them what support they need most this week.

entries.quote: The function of leadership is to produce more leaders, not more followers.
entries.author: Ralph Nader
entries.task: Delegate a decision you would normally make yourself. Let the other person own the outcome.

entries.quote: Leadership is the capacity to translate vision into reality.
entries.author: Warren Bennis
entries.task: Write one sentence describing the vision for your team or family, then share it with someone.

entries.quote: Before you are a leader, success is all about growing yourself. When you become a leader, success is about growing others.
entries.author: Jack Welch
entries.task: Spend 15 minutes coaching a colleague or family member on something they want to improve.

entries.quote: Leadership is not about titles, positions, or flowcharts. It is about one life influencing another.
entries.author: John C. Maxwell
entries.task: Send a note of appreciation to someone whose work you rely on quietly.

entries.quote: The greatest leader is not necessarily the one who does the greatest things. He is the one that gets the people to do the greatest things.
entries.author: Ronald Reagan
entries.task: In your next meeting, speak last. Invite others to speak first and build on their ideas.

entries.quote: Example is not the main thing in influencing others. It is the only thing.
entries.author: Albert Schweitzer
entries.task: Pick one behavior you want your team to adopt and model it deliberately today.

categories.name: Assertiveness
categories.summary: Speak your truth with clarity and respect.

entries.quote: The basic difference between being assertive and being aggressive is how our words and behavior affect the rights and well-being of others.
entries.author: Sharon Anthony Bower
entries.task: Say 'no' once today to a request that does not fit your priorities, without apologizing excessively.

entries.quote: You have the right to say what you need to say.
entries.author: Unknown
entries.task: Name one thing you have been avoiding saying, then say it to the person who needs to hear it.

entries.quote: Speak your mind, even if your voice shakes.
entries.author: Maggie Kuhn
entries.task: In your next conversation, state one opinion clearly starting with 'I think' or 'I believe'.

entries.quote: It is not your job to make people comfortable with your honesty.
entries.author: Unknown
entries.task: Ask directly for something you want today. No hints, no hedging.

entries.quote: Assertiveness is not what you do, it's who you are.
entries.author: Shakti Gawain
entries.task: Notice one moment of self-doubt today and replace the thought with a calm, confident statement.

entries.quote: Stand firm in your refusal to remain conscious during algebra. In real life, I assure you, there is no such thing as algebra.
entries.author: Fran Lebowitz
entries.task: Draw one clear boundary today and communicate it plainly to the person it concerns.

categories.name: Quality
categories.summary: Do a few things, and do them excellently.

entries.quote: Quality is never an accident; it is always the result of intelligent effort.
entries.author: John Ruskin
entries.task: Pick one piece of work on your plate today and improve it by 10% before calling it done.

entries.quote: Quality means doing it right when no one is looking.
entries.author: Henry Ford
entries.task: Revisit a task you finished yesterday and inspect it as if a stranger had done it for you.

entries.quote: Excellence is the gradual result of always striving to do better.
entries.author: Pat Riley
entries.task: Identify the one detail in today's work most likely to be ignored, and get it right.

entries.quote: Be a yardstick of quality. Some people aren't used to an environment where excellence is expected.
entries.author: Steve Jobs
entries.task: Set a clear quality bar for one deliverable today. Write it down before you start.

entries.quote: If a job is worth doing, it is worth doing well.
entries.author: Proverb
entries.task: Cut one task from your day so you can do another one properly.

entries.quote: Quality is not an act, it is a habit.
entries.author: Aristotle
entries.task: Establish a 5-minute review ritual at the end of one task today. Check, refine, then ship.

categories.name: Large Life
categories.summary: Live expansively; refuse a small, fearful existence.

entries.quote: Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
entries.author: Anais Nin
entries.task: Do one thing today that slightly scares you but you know would make you proud.

entries.quote: Do not go where the path may lead, go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
entries.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
entries.task: Try one small thing you've never tried before - a route, a food, a conversation.

entries.quote: The purpose of life is to live it, to taste experience to the utmost.
entries.author: Eleanor Roosevelt
entries.task: Spend 20 minutes outside with your phone in your pocket. Just notice the world.

entries.quote: You only live once, but if you do it right, once is enough.
entries.author: Mae West
entries.task: Write down one thing you want to experience this year and schedule the first step today.

entries.quote: Twenty years from now you will be more disappointed by the things you didn't do than by the ones you did.
entries.author: Mark Twain
entries.task: Reach out to one person you admire but have never contacted. Send a short, genuine message.

entries.quote: The biggest adventure you can take is to live the life of your dreams.
entries.author: Oprah Winfrey
entries.task: Describe your ideal day in three sentences. Identify the one element you can bring into today.

categories.name: Commitment
categories.summary: Keep promises, especially the ones made to yourself.

entries.quote: Unless commitment is made, there are only promises and hopes, but no plans.
entries.author: Peter F. Drucker
entries.task: Turn one vague intention into a specific commitment with a time, date, and next step.

entries.quote: Commitment is what transforms a promise into reality.
entries.author: Abraham Lincoln
entries.task: Finish one task today that you have been postponing for more than a week.

entries.quote: Stay committed to your decisions, but stay flexible in your approach.
entries.author: Tony Robbins
entries.task: Review one goal you set this month. Keep the goal, but change one tactic that isn't working.

entries.quote: There's a difference between interest and commitment. When you're interested in doing something, you do it only when it's convenient. When you're committed, you accept no excuses, only results.
entries.author: Kenneth Blanchard
entries.task: Protect one hour today for your most important commitment. No phone, no meetings.

entries.quote: Most people fail, not because of lack of desire, but because of lack of commitment.
entries.author: Vince Lombardi
entries.task: Write down the one commitment you will honor today no matter what. Then honor it.

entries.quote: Once you make a decision, the universe conspires to make it happen.
entries.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
entries.task: Publicly commit to a goal by telling one person exactly what you will do and by when.

entries.quote: Gratitude turns what we have into enough.
entries.author: Aesop
entries.task: Write down three specific things you are grateful for today. No repeats from yesterday.

entries.quote: The roots of all goodness lie in the soil of appreciation for goodness.
entries.author: Dalai Lama
entries.task: Thank someone today in a way that names exactly what they did and why it mattered.

entries.quote: When you are grateful, fear disappears and abundance appears.
entries.author: Anthony Robbins
entries.task: Before your next meal, pause for 15 seconds and silently acknowledge the path that brought it to you.

entries.quote: Gratitude is not only the greatest of virtues, but the parent of all the others.
entries.author: Cicero
entries.task: Reread a message from someone who once helped you. Let it land. Consider replying, even years late.

categories.name: Discipline
categories.summary: Do what matters, especially when you don't feel like it.

entries.quote: Discipline is choosing between what you want now and what you want most.
entries.author: Abraham Lincoln
entries.task: Identify one impulse you will resist today in service of a larger goal.

entries.quote: We do not rise to the level of our goals. We fall to the level of our systems.
entries.author: James Clear
entries.task: Fix one friction point in your daily routine so the right action becomes the easy action.

entries.quote: Discipline equals freedom.
entries.author: Jocko Willink
entries.task: Do the hardest thing on your list first today, before checking any messages.

entries.quote: Motivation gets you going, but discipline keeps you growing.
entries.author: John C. Maxwell
entries.task: Complete one repetition of a habit you want to build, even if you only have five minutes.
